paragraphs.text: The four-day working week has been tested in several countries. In a large trial in the United Kingdom in 2022, 61 companies reduced working hours by around 20% without cutting pay. At the end of the six-month trial, 56 of them chose to continue, and revenue at participating firms stayed broadly the same. Employees reported less stress and better sleep. Critics point out, however, that the companies volunteered to take part and were mostly small firms in office-based sectors, so the results may not apply to hospitals, factories or schools.
